name: Trade Coalition
role: Corporate/economic power bloc within the Galactic Union
description: A corporate and economic power bloc operating inside Union politics. Canon establishes three things about it: it was one leg of the alliance that carried Chancellor Zylox to the chancellorship (Trade Coalition + AI Vanguard + economic technocrats, narrowly defeating a military-backed candidate); its headquarters sits on the Union capital, the "Engine of the Union" and wealthiest world; and it brokered neutral ceasefire zones enabling controlled trade between Union, separatist and neutral parties.
political_role: Its backing is a standing constraint on the chancellorship — canon describes Zylox as viewed by Outer Colony leaders as a corporate-controlled figurehead, with corporate-versus-government interests straining as private security expands.
notes: Created 2026-08-09. A named power bloc attested repeatedly in committed canon (chancellorship alliance, capital HQ, ceasefire-zone brokerage) that had no entity record. All attributes recovered from canon; nothing invented.
